record.paper_title: Some open problems in the theory of almost periodic functions
record.context_brief: Relations between APr and classical almost-periodic spaces
record.original_question: For the scale of spaces APr(R, C) obtained by completing the trigonometric polynomials T(t)=∑_{k=1}^n a_k e^{iλ_k t} under the norm ||T||_r=(∑_{k=1}^n |a_k|^r)^{1/r} for 1<r<2, determine how these spaces relate to the classical almost-periodic function spaces discussed in the paper, namely AP1 (almost periodic functions with absolutely convergent Fourier series), AP (Bohr almost periodic functions), Stepanov space S, Weyl space APW, Besicovitch spaces Bp, and pseudo almost periodic functions PAP.

evidence.quote: a) What are the relationships between the spaces APr and the classical spaces mentioned above?

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem about the scale of spaces $AP^r$ obtained by $\ell^r$-completion of trigonometric polynomials. General references on almost periodic functions (Bohr, Stepanov, Weyl, Besicovitch, pseudo almost periodic) treat the classical spaces but do not provide a complete description of how the intermediate $AP^r$ ($1<r<2$) spaces sit relative to them. No subsequent work establishing such full relations was located.

status_evidence.title: Almost periodic function - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: All spaces of almost periodic functions can be obtained as completions of trigonometric polynomials under various norms (Bohr uniform, Stepanov, Weyl, Besicovitch).
status_evidence.claim: Provides background on the classical spaces but does not address the intermediate scale APr for 1<r<2.

status_evidence.title: Almost Periodic Functions and Their Applications: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of almost periodic function classes and their generalizations.
status_evidence.claim: Survey does not record a resolution of the relations between the APr scale and classical AP spaces.
